title: Calvin Harris - I'm Not Alone (Camelphat Rmx)

lines.l: Am I living? Does this mean that I'm not alone?
God, I can do this anymore
If I see a light flash in, could this leave the unknown alone?
If I see a mind flash in, could this leave the unknown alone?
And if I see a light flashing, could this be the uncommon hour?
If I see a fire, could this be the uncommon hour?
